title: Orbit-Planner: Towards Latent World Models for On-Orbit Obstacle Avoidance of Satellite Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.16651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Satellite agents for on-orbit navigation tasks need to predict collision risks using limited onboard observations. However, conventional planners often rely on predefined maps and fixed environmental assumptions, limiting their adaptability in dynamic on-orbit scenarios. In this paper, we propose Orbit-Planner, a two-stage latent world model for on-orbit obstacle avoidance. Orbit-Planner learns action-conditioned spacecraft dynamics to perform future-state rollouts in latent space, and introduces a Physics Probe to decode physical state changes from imagined latent trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that Orbit-Planner can perform long-horizon latent rollouts and recover physical states from imagined trajectories. In closed-loop obstacle-avoidance navigation in Isaac Sim, it attains a success rate of 91.7%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhijianLi2003/Orbit_Planner.

translated_title: 轨道规划器：面向卫星代理在轨避障的潜在世界模型
translated_abstract: 用于在轨导航任务的卫星代理需要利用有限的车载观测来预测碰撞风险。然而，传统规划器通常依赖于预定义地图和固定环境假设，限制了它们在动态在轨场景中的适应性。在本文中，我们提出了轨道规划器（Orbit-Planner），一种用于在轨避障的两阶段潜在世界模型。轨道规划器学习动作条件下的航天器动力学，以在潜在空间中进行未来状态推演，并引入物理探测器（Physics Probe）从想象的潜在轨迹中解码物理状态变化。实验表明，轨道规划器能够执行长时域潜在推演，并从想象轨迹中恢复物理状态。在Isaac Sim中的闭环避障导航中，它达到了91.7%的成功率。代码可在https://github.com/ZhijianLi2003/Orbit_Planner获取。
tldr: 本文提出轨道规划器，一种两阶段潜在世界模型，通过潜在空间推演和物理状态解码，实现在轨卫星动态避障，在模拟中达到91.7%的成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Orbit-Planner, a two-stage latent world model that enables on-orbit satellite obstacle avoidance via latent-space rollouts and physical state decoding, achieving a 91.7% success rate in simulation.
